reasons: CS4215 and CS4247 are offered only in Semester 2, but Semester 8 is an exchange semester with no modules.
CS4234 and CS3227 are fixed in Semester 7, so there is no non-exchange Semester 2 left for CS4215 or CS4247.
CS4247 also needs CS3241 and must follow CS4234, which cannot be satisfied within semesters 7 and 8.
